newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia c.bank devolves some f/x rules to branches.
newsitem.headline: Russia c.bank devolves some f/x rules to branches.

text.p: Russia's central bank will allow its branches in the regions to grant permits to carry out some hard currency operations from November 1, a senior central bank official said on Tuesday.

Central bank branches will have the right to grant permits to companies to defer payments for over 180 days on export and import contracts of up to $10 million, central bank hard currency regulation and supervision head Viktor Melnikov told a news conference.

The branches will also have the right to give permits to Russian residents to open hard currency accounts in foreign banks to service the current expenses of their representative offices abroad, he said.
Previously, the central bank itself had been responsible for these permits.
